rationale: EASA NPA 2025-07(B) Section DS.AI.010(d) explicitly excludes AI-based systems presenting a risk directly contributing to fatalities or multiple life-threatening injuries, as well as online-learning systems whose failure contribution exceeds 'no safety effect'. The claim is scoped specifically to this limitation of the proposed framework and correctly concludes that DS.AI cannot serve as a complete proposed path for the most demanding flight-critical case without function-level failure allocation and architectural mitigations, which the manuscript and artifacts also acknowledge.
evidence_locators: EASA NPA 2025-07 (B), PDF p. 4, DS.AI.010 Scope(d)(1)-(2)
limitations: Applies to EASA NPA 2025-07(B) as proposed; future revisions, AMC/GM changes, or an architecture that mitigates an AI component to a non-direct failure contribution would alter applicability to a specific airframe.
